messages.subject: Argument 'control.data' have changed name to 'control.family'
parts:
The testing-version of today includes the following change:

Argument 'control.data' have changed name into 'control.family'.

Your old code will still work. You'll get a warning the first time you
use the argument 'control.data', unless you set

inla.setOption(show.warning.control.data=FALSE)

The change makes the naming convention more logical, as argument
'family' defines the likelihood and 'control.family' control its
arguments.

--
